scope: Four focal countries, bounded by the retained evidence inspected through 2 October 2026. Readings are attributed evidence assessments, not national legal determinations, scholarly rulings, certificates or quantitative scenario gate values.

reading_definitions.supported_conditional: The named actor’s retained account describes a conditional path for this reference profile, subject to every stated condition. No national adoption, matched product approval or certificate follows.
reading_definitions.disputed: Applicable retained texts establish differing positions within the explicitly named scope; this label alone would not establish a formal institutional dispute.
reading_definitions.leans_closed: A checked applicable position supports an adverse reading within its named scope; an unconfirmed lead cannot supply this label.
reading_definitions.conditions_not_met: Checked applicable evidence identifies an unmet condition for the exact matched process version; an unmatched historical report cannot supply this label.
reading_definitions.unresolved: The inspected evidence does not establish an applicable classification for the named authority and matched process, or retained formulations remain unreconciled.
reading_definitions.no_institutional_text_located: No applicable institutional text was located in this bounded retained packet through 2 October 2026; this is not an exhaustive absence finding.
reading_definitions.general_route_no_cultivated_scheme: The named official account describes a general halal certification system. No cultivated-specific scheme is established by this packet; full operative scope remains unverified.
reading_definitions.contested_domestic_route: Applicable evidence would establish the specified domestic certification route and dispute; export rules or news context alone are insufficient.
reading_definitions.route_exists_no_approval: The retained government account describes a food-authorization route covering cell-based food. No product approval is established in this packet; the complete operative standard remains unread.
reading_definitions.application_pending: The retained register places a named application under process, but its mixed stage code leaves the actual decision unresolved.
reading_definitions.route_announced_status_unknown: A route has been announced; whether it operates is unknown.
reading_definitions.no_route_identified: No applicable cultivated-food authorization route was identified in this bounded packet through 2 October 2026; generic procedures and unlocated instruments remain open.
reading_definitions.whole_market_gate: Applicable operative evidence would establish halal status as a condition across the defined market, including relevant channel and product scope.
reading_definitions.segment_gate: Applicable legal and demand evidence would establish a defined subset of purchases contingent on halal status; a supply share alone is insufficient.
reading_definitions.unverified: The inspected evidence does not establish this reading or scope.

reading_labels.general_route_no_cultivated_scheme: General system described; cultivated scope open

confidence_definitions.low: Evidence is unresolved, incomplete, contextual or inferential; no positive or adverse determination follows.
confidence_definitions.medium: At least one checked applicable source supports the narrowly attributed reading. This does not establish complete legal coverage, scholarly acceptance or product certification.
confidence_definitions.high: Would require checked applicable direct evidence for every asserted actor and substantive reading; not used here.
